convencoes.observacao: O desenvolvimento e modelado em portugues, mas nomes e textos exibidos ao jogador devem ser preenchidos em ingles.

schema_resumo_pt.cosmoble: Se a carta pode virar Cosmo Base
schema_resumo_pt.custo: Custo principal para jogar a carta
schema_resumo_pt.unidade_custo: Tipo do custo principal, por exemplo cosmo ou base_cosmo
schema_resumo_pt.habilidades_en: Lista de habilidades e regras em ingles
schema_resumo_pt.domain_padrao: Para cartas do tipo Domain, custo, unidade_custo, cosmoble, power, resistance, equipar_custo e damage_cloth devem ficar null.

notas_pt: Base catalogada a partir dos PNGs existentes em /CARDS e da lista oficial enviada pelo autor.
Athena foi expandida com dados completos de design.
Cartas sem PNG no projeto foram marcadas como design-ready.
Na beta Athena v0.1, Sanctuary, Star Hill e Coliseum sao tratados como Domains oficiais.
O escopo ativo da beta nao usa o tipo Local.

habilidades_en: Cosmo of Hope — Whenever one or more Athena Devotees you control survive combat during your opponent's turn, generate 1 Latent Cosmo.

Athena's Prayer — Cost: 5 Cosmo. When an Athena Devotee is destroyed and sent to Tartarus, you may pay 5 Cosmo. If you do, return that Devotee to the battlefield Unprepared. Put a +1/+1 counter on that Devotee. You may equip a Cloth to it ignoring equip cost.
cartas.habilidade_awaken_en: Seventh Sense — Athena Devotees you control get +1/+1. Awaken Ability — Cost: 5 Cosmo. If an Athena Devotee would be destroyed, you may pay 5 Cosmo. If you do, it is not destroyed and its Resistance becomes 1 instead.
cartas.ultimate_en: Athena Exclamation — Cost: 15 Cosmo. Destroy all enemy Devotees. For each Devotee destroyed this way, its controller loses 1 Soul.
cartas.notas_pt: Carta de Deus principal da faccao Athena.

habilidades_en: When Seiya attacks, you may pay 1 Latent Cosmo. If you do, Seiya gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
If Seiya would be destroyed, you may pay 3 Latent Cosmo. If you do, return Seiya to the battlefield Unprepared.
Pegasus Ryuseiken — Cost: 5 Base Cosmo. Seiya gets +3/+2 until end of turn. If Seiya is equipped with a Cloth, he gains Pierce this combat.
If Shiryu is equipped with a Cloth, Shiryu gets +1/+1.
If Shiryu would be destroyed, you may destroy a Cloth equipped to Shiryu instead.

Rozan Shoryuha — Cost: 6 Base Cosmo. Shiryu deals 4 damage to target Devotee. You may destroy a Cloth equipped to Shiryu. If you do, this Technique costs 0 instead. Use this ability only once each turn.
When Hyoga deals combat damage to a Devotee, put a Seal counter on that Devotee.
Devotees with Seal counters get -1/-0 while Hyoga is Prepared.
Diamond Dust — Cost: 4 Base Cosmo. Deal 1 damage to all enemy Devotees. Put a Seal counter on each Devotee damaged this way.
When Shun enters the battlefield, return target enemy Devotee with cost 1 or less to its owner's hand.
When a Devotee attacks Shun, return that Devotee to its owner's hand after combat.
Nebula Chain — Cost: 4 Base Cosmo. Return up to 2 target enemy Devotees to their owners' hands. Those Devotees cannot be played again this turn.
cartas.notas_pt: Usando a arte v2 de Andromeda como versao principal.

habilidades_en: If you used 3 or more Abilities, Moments, or Techniques this turn, you may return Ikki from Tartarus to the battlefield Unprepared.
Houou Genma-Ken — Whenever Ikki deals combat damage to a Devotee, you may pay 6 Cosmo. If you do, gain control of that Devotee until end of turn. Prepare that Devotee.
Hoyoku Tensho — Cost: 5 Cosmo, Tap Ikki. Deal 3 damage to target Devotee or God.
cartas.notas_pt: Grafia ASCII aplicada ao nome da tecnica.

habilidades_en: When Marin enters the battlefield, another target Devotee you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Tap: Generate 1 Latent Cosmo.
Whenever Shaina enters combat, put a -1/-1 counter on target enemy Devotee.
cartas.notas_pt: Nome normalizado para Shaina para combinar com o asset existente.

cartas.nome_interno_pt: Saga, Cavaleiro de Ouro de Gemeos
habilidades_en: Gemini Illusion — Once per turn, when an enemy Technique targets a Devotee, you may change the target to another valid Devotee.
Another Dimension — Cost: 3 Latent Cosmo, Tap Saga. Exile target Devotee with cost 3 or less. Return that Devotee to the battlefield under its owner's control at the end of the next turn Unprepared.

Galaxian Explosion — Awakened — Cost: 8 Base Cosmo. Choose target opponent. Deal damage to all other Devotees equal to that player's Latent Cosmo. Devotees destroyed this way are exiled instead of going to Tartarus.

cartas.nome_interno_pt: Aiolos, Cavaleiro de Ouro de Sagitario
habilidades_en: Other Athena Devotees you control get +0/+1. If they are equipped with a Cloth, they get +1/+1 instead.
Aiolos can block Nimble Devotees.
Sagittarius Arrow — Awakened — Cost: X Base Cosmo. Deal X damage to target Devotee or God, where X equals your God's current Soul.

cartas.nome_interno_pt: Aldebaran, Cavaleiro de Ouro de Touro
habilidades_en: Enemy Devotees with Power 3 or less cannot attack your God.
Whenever Aldebaran survives combat, deal 1 damage to the enemy Devotee.
Great Horn — Cost: 4 Base Cosmo. Aldebaran gets +3/+0 and Pierce this combat.

cartas.nome_interno_pt: Deathmask, Cavaleiro de Ouro de Cancer
habilidades_en: Whenever a Devotee is destroyed, its controller loses 1 Soul.
Underworld Waves — Cost: 5 Base Cosmo. Exile all Devotees from Tartarus. For each Devotee exiled this way, generate 1 Latent Cosmo.

cartas.nome_interno_pt: Camus, Cavaleiro de Ouro de Aquario
habilidades_en: Devotees with Seal counters get -1/-1.
Once per turn, when you put a Seal counter on a Devotee, you may put a Seal counter on another target Devotee.
Aurora Execution — Cost: 6 Base Cosmo. Deal 1 damage to all enemy Devotees. Destroy all Devotees with a Seal counter.
When Sanctuary Guard enters the battlefield, you may equip a Cloth with equip cost 1 or less to it without paying its equip cost.
Tap: Generate 1 Latent Cosmo.
Sanctuary Archer can attack Devotees with Nimble.
Tap: Prevent the next 2 damage that would be dealt to target Devotee this turn.
cartas.notas_pt: O nome da carta foi normalizado para Sanctuary Healer; o asset exportado usa SANCTUMHEALER.
